author: DamiLee
description:
Most men think about the Roman Empire at least once a day. But why does a civilization that collapsed 1,500 years ago still live rent free in our heads?

It's not just Gladiator. It's not just the engineering or the emperors. The real reason is stranger than any of that, and it says a lot about how power actually works.

Because the way we think about Rome? That's probably exactly how they wanted to be remembered. The conquest, the glory, the arena. Not the reality, that most of the Roman population was poor, unemployed, and constantly on the edge of starvation.

Rome pulled off one of the most powerful branding campaigns in history, and we're still running the ad.

Comment ROME below and I'll send you the link to find out how they did it.

title: You Remember Rome Exactly How Rome Wanted
